They stand close, smiling, clinking a gold gemmed chalice and a clear crystal glass so the rims clearly touch at center. Hands show believable finger grip on stems. Behind them a soft shallow-focus fairy-tale castle with purple roofs sits mid-distance under bright warm sunny sky, slightly offset so crowns keep clean sky silhouette. Soft plastic casual mobile-game render, Royal Match grade: sunny gold #F5C542 dominant, castle purple #7B5CDB accents, coat red #E23B3B and sky cyan #3DB8E8 accents, clean soft-render cel shading, soft upper-side daylight, rounded toy-like forms, small clean highlights not oily. Faces large and emotional; no dog, no third character, no breakfast table, no parasol, no logo or UI text, no full-body legs. Borrow style only from the style pad — do not copy its table-group layout, lawn dining framing, or three-subject partition.
